'''Atai Molec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]], ruler of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. He served as the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of Zygerria and the [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]]. After Scintel's death, Atai took her place as ruler of Zygerria. Married to a Zygerrian woman, he was the father of [[Hordem Molec/Legends|Hordem]] and [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]].<ref name="Friends" />

==Biography==
[[File:AtaiMolecHS-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Atai Molec holding a powered down electro-whip]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Atai Molec worked with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Battle of Kiros]]. He was receiving the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and was beside Dooku when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] commanded [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] to bring [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to him on his knees.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> Molec then ran into [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] dressed in [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], who claimed to have news of [[Bruno Denturri/Legends|Bruno Denturri]]. On [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] order he brought Skywalker, claiming to be [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lars Quell]] to the Queen. After Kenobi was captured trying to free [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]], Kenobi was held [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by the Zygerrians. Molec recognized Kenobi from the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Molec then informed the Queen of his discovery and had Kenobi brought to the auction. When Skywalker revealed himself to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], a fight broke out in the arena between the Jedi and the Zygerrians. Molec was subdued by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. She was then knocked out by the Queen.

After the fight, Molec taunted Tano, who was in a cage above the [[Royal Palace of Zygerria/Legends|palace]], that once Skywalker was subdued, she would belong to him, to do with whatever he wanted. Tano pushed him off the edge of the building [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]], nearly causing him to fall to his death. Molec then proceeded to shock Tano multiple times through her [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]].<ref name="SotR">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> Molec then, unbeknownst to his queen, invited Count Dooku to Zygerria. Molec informed his queen of Dooku's arrival and brought her to the palace to speak with the Separatist leader. There, the Queen told the Count of her plan to enslave the Jedi. Though Dooku was impressed with her plan, he was only interested in wiping out the Jedi and ordered the Queen to execute Skywalker. When she refused, Molec and Dooku betrayed her, saying that the Jedi (omitting Tano) must die and that she was unfit to be queen.<ref name="EfK">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> After Scintel's death, Molec ascended to the throne as the king.<ref name="Friends" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Atai.png|thumb|right|200px|Atai, as he appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'']] comics]]
Atai Molec was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series' first story arc, [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'']], that ran from [[September 10]], [[2008]] to [[May 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="SotRComic">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic]]''</ref> The story arc was later adapted for screen by the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, spanning the episodes "[[Kidnapped]],"<ref name="Kidnapped" /> "[[Slaves of the Republic]],"<ref name="SotR" /> and "[[Escape from Kadavo]]."<ref name="EfK" /> The televised episodes effectively supplanted the comic series' former place in [[canon]].<ref name="Chee Facebook">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|name=Leland Chee|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=295828993771367&id=201820953172172|nobackup=1}}</ref> Actor [[Ricardo Mamood Vega]] voiced Atai Molec in ''The Clone Wars'' television series.<ref name="SotR" />

The ''[[Friends Like These]]'' [[roleplaying game]] adventure book, published [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]], made mention of Atai Molec and his history after the Clone Wars while discussing his newly introduced son, [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]].<ref name="Friends" />
